verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp using streamable HTTP and in-browser OAuth, with an official Claude Code plugin that connects to it. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint is live and returns a proper MCP OAuth 401 challenge, and the probe notes it exposes search, fetch, and a virtual `poly` CLI as tools. Missing for 10: independent community hands-on reports of agents actually using the MCP tools beyond the auth handshake.
